about: Dex sections in display order. ankcGroupId links the 7 official groups to data/ankc-breeds.json; the bonus section holds data/unofficial-breeds.json.

groups.name: Toys
groups.description: Small companion breeds bred to be lap dogs, like the Cavalier, Pug and Maltese.

groups.name: Terriers
groups.description: Feisty, energetic dogs first bred to hunt vermin, like the Jack Russell, Staffy and Westie.

groups.name: Gundogs
groups.description: Bred to find and retrieve game for hunters, like the Labrador, Golden Retriever and spaniels.

groups.name: Hounds
groups.description: Hunters by scent or sight, like the Beagle, Dachshund, Greyhound and Whippet.

groups.name: Working Dogs
groups.description: The herding and droving breeds, like the Border Collie, Kelpie and Cattle Dog.

groups.name: Utility
groups.description: Guarding, sledding and other jobs, like the Rottweiler, Boxer and Siberian Husky.

groups.name: Non Sporting
groups.description: Companion breeds that don't fit elsewhere, like the Poodle, French Bulldog and Great Dane.

groups.name: Bonus
groups.description: Popular dogs that Dogs Australia doesn't recognise, like the Cavoodle, Groodle and Mini Foxie.
